messages:
nina: alert from support: multiple tenants lost SCIM group sync after a scheduled RBAC tighten and key rotation at ~02:10 UTC.

raj: can you share example errors?

nina: from provisioner logs:
```
2026-03-25T02:11:13Z ERROR scim-provisioner PATCH /Groups failed status=403 body="forbidden" tx=tr-9a
2026-03-25T02:11:14Z WARN kms unwrap failed key=svc-token err="key disabled"
```

sam: we ran a JWK rotation at 02:08 and an RBAC prune at 02:09. Did the prune remove the system principal mapping that the provisioning service relies on?

nina: console audit shows prune job by deploy-bot at 02:09:05 targeting role:scim-writer but entries about svc principal removal are missing (audit consumer restarted).

raj: if the key was disabled during unwrap, tokens could have failed and triggered fallback logic that tries to reauthorize and then deprovision. Combined with missing role mapping that could trigger actual deprovs.

sam: temporary mitigation: pause scim worker and rollback RBAC prune. I'll run rollback now: `./ops/role-pruner rollback --to 2026-03-25T02:09`

infra-bot: role-pruner rollback queued by sam. ETA 90s.

nina: muting scim queue to stop further churn. infra-bot mute-queue scim 30m

raj: follow-ups: 1) extract audit logs from cold storage to see what changed for svc accounts; 2) ensure KMS rotations do not briefly disable previous key versions; 3) add a pruning precheck to ensure any service principals retain minimum scim roles.

sam: opening INC-20260325-11 and will notify customers. brief note: coordinated maintenance (jwk rotate + kms rewrap + rbac prune) led to transient provisioning failures and accidental group removals; rolling back and reconciling.

nina: uploading logs to secure blob and will attach to incident. link: https://internal.redwood/logs/2026-03-25/scim-tr-9a

raj: I'll own the PR for precheck and a CI smoke test post-rotation. sam please add timeline to the incident.

sam: will do.
